description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `isPalindrome(text)` koja vraća `true` ako se tekst isto čita sa obe strane.

Velika i mala slova se ne razlikuju, a razmaci i znaci interpunkcije se ignorišu (računaju se samo slova a-z i cifre).

Primeri:
- `isPalindrome('level')` → `true`
- `isPalindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama')` → `true`
- `isPalindrome('hello')` → `false`
description.en:
Write a function `isPalindrome(text)` that returns `true` if the text reads the same from both ends.

Letter case does not matter, and spaces and punctuation are ignored (only the letters a-z and digits count).

Examples:
- `isPalindrome('level')` → `true`
- `isPalindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama')` → `true`
- `isPalindrome('hello')` → `false`

label.en: clean, then compare with the reverse

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function isPalindrome` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(text)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: kad pozovemo `isPalindrome('level')`, unutar funkcije je `text` jednako `'level'`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 4.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function isPalindrome` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(text)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: when we call `isPalindrome('level')`, inside the function `text` equals `'level'`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 4 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Pravimo „očišćenu“ verziju teksta: sve malim slovima, bez razmaka i interpunkcije.

- `const cleaned` pravi promenljivu koja se ne dodeljuje ponovo.
- `text.toLowerCase()` pretvara sva slova u mala, pa `A` i `a` postaju ista stvar. Stringovi su nepromenljivi, pa dobijamo novi string.
- `.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')` zamenjuje delove teksta koji odgovaraju šablonu. Šablon `/[^a-z0-9]/g` je regularni izraz: `[ ]` je skup znakova, `a-z` i `0-9` su opsezi (slova i cifre), a `^` na početku skupa znači „sve osim“. Dakle, „bilo koji znak koji NIJE malo slovo ili cifra“.
- `g` na kraju znači „globalno“: zameni sve pojave, ne samo prvu.
- `''` je zamena: prazan string, tj. te znakove brišemo.
- Redosled je bitan: prvo `toLowerCase`, pa onda `replace`. Da je obrnuto, velika slova bi bila obrisana jer nisu u opsegu `a-z`.
- Ograničenje: slova van engleske abecede (č, š, ž) se brišu, jer nisu u `a-z`.

Primer:

```
'A man, a plan' → toLowerCase → 'a man, a plan'
               → replace      → 'amanaplan'
```
text.en:
We build a “cleaned” version of the text: all lowercase, without spaces and punctuation.

- `const cleaned` creates a variable that is not reassigned.
- `text.toLowerCase()` converts all letters to lowercase, so `A` and `a` become the same thing. Strings are immutable, so we get a new string.
- `.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')` replaces the parts of the text that match the pattern. The pattern `/[^a-z0-9]/g` is a regular expression: `[ ]` is a set of characters, `a-z` and `0-9` are ranges (letters and digits), and `^` at the start of the set means “anything except”. So, “any character that is NOT a lowercase letter or a digit”.
- `g` at the end means “global”: replace all occurrences, not just the first.
- `''` is the replacement: an empty string, i.e. we delete those characters.
- The order matters: first `toLowerCase`, then `replace`. The other way round, capital letters would be deleted because they are not in the range `a-z`.
- Limitation: letters outside the English alphabet (č, š, ž) are deleted, because they are not in `a-z`.

Example:

```
'A man, a plan' → toLowerCase → 'a man, a plan'
               → replace      → 'amanaplan'
```

text.sr:
Poredimo očišćeni tekst sa njegovom obrnutom verzijom.

- `[...cleaned].reverse().join('')` pravi obrnuti string: spread rastavlja na znakove, `reverse` okreće redosled, `join('')` spaja nazad (isto kao u zadatku „Obrni string“).
- `===` poredi dva stringa po vrednosti i vraća `true` ili `false`. Taj rezultat se direktno vraća, pa nije potreban `if`.
- Za prazan tekst je `cleaned` jednako `''`, a `'' === ''` je `true`, što test traži.

```
cleaned = 'amanaplanacanalpanama'
obrnuto = 'amanaplanacanalpanama'   → true

cleaned = 'hello'
obrnuto = 'olleh'                   → false
```
text.en:
We compare the cleaned text with its reversed version.

- `[...cleaned].reverse().join('')` builds the reversed string: spread splits into characters, `reverse` reverses the order, `join('')` joins back (the same as in the “Reverse a string” exercise).
- `===` compares two strings by value and returns `true` or `false`. That result is returned directly, so no `if` is needed.
- For empty text `cleaned` is `''`, and `'' === ''` is `true`, which the test requires.

```
cleaned = 'amanaplanacanalpanama'
reversed = 'amanaplanacanalpanama'  → true

cleaned = 'hello'
reversed = 'olleh'                  → false
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Prvo se tekst normalizuje (mala slova, bez znakova), pa se poredi sa svojom obrnutom verzijom.
note.en: The text is normalized first (lowercase, no symbols), then compared with its own reversed version.

text.sr:
Isto čišćenje kao u prvom rešenju: mala slova, pa brisanje svega što nije slovo `a-z` ili cifra.

- `text.toLowerCase()` pretvara slova u mala.
- `.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')` briše svaki znak koji nije malo slovo ili cifra (`^` unutar `[ ]` znači „sve osim“, `g` znači „sve pojave“).
- Rezultat je u `cleaned`, npr. `'A man, a plan'` postaje `'amanaplan'`.
text.en:
The same cleaning as in the first solution: lowercase, then deleting everything that is not a letter `a-z` or a digit.

- `text.toLowerCase()` turns the letters into lowercase.
- `.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')` deletes every character that is not a lowercase letter or a digit (`^` inside `[ ]` means “anything except”, `g` means “all occurrences”).
- The result is in `cleaned`, e.g. `'A man, a plan'` becomes `'amanaplan'`.

text.sr:
Levi „pokazivač“: indeks znaka koji gledamo sa početka.

- `let left = 0;` pravi promenljivu sa vrednošću `0`, jer prvi znak stringa ima indeks 0.
- „Pokazivač“ je samo broj koji pokazuje na mesto u stringu. `let` jer će se pomerati udesno.
text.en:
The left “pointer”: the index of the character we look at from the start.

- `let left = 0;` creates a variable with the value `0`, because the first character of a string has index 0.
- A “pointer” is just a number that points to a place in the string. `let` because it will move to the right.

text.sr:
Desni pokazivač: indeks poslednjeg znaka.

- `cleaned.length` je broj znakova. Indeksi idu od `0` do `length - 1`, pa je poslednji znak na `cleaned.length - 1`.
- Za `'level'` dužina je 5, pa je `right = 4`.
- Za prazan string `right` je `-1`.
text.en:
The right pointer: the index of the last character.

- `cleaned.length` is the number of characters. Indexes go from `0` to `length - 1`, so the last character is at `cleaned.length - 1`.
- For `'level'` the length is 5, so `right = 4`.
- For an empty string `right` is `-1`.

text.sr:
Petlja `while` ponavlja telo dok god je uslov tačan.

- `while (uslov) { ... }` proverava uslov pre svakog ponavljanja; kad postane `false`, petlja se završava.
- `left < right` znači da se pokazivači još nisu sreli. Kad se sretnu (neparna dužina, srednji znak) ili mimoiđu (parna dužina), sve parove smo već uporedili.
- Srednji znak se ne poredi, jer je uvek jednak samom sebi.
- Za prazan string uslov `0 < -1` nije tačan, pa se petlja ne izvršava nijednom.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 9.
text.en:
The `while` loop repeats its body as long as the condition is true.

- `while (condition) { ... }` checks the condition before every repetition; when it becomes `false`, the loop ends.
- `left < right` means the pointers have not met yet. When they meet (odd length, the middle character) or pass each other (even length), we have already compared all the pairs.
- The middle character is not compared, because it is always equal to itself.
- For an empty string the condition `0 < -1` is not true, so the loop does not run at all.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 9.

text.sr:
Poredimo znak sa leve i znak sa desne strane.

- `cleaned[left]` je znak na indeksu `left`, a `cleaned[right]` znak na indeksu `right`.
- `!==` je stroga nejednakost: `true` ako se znakovi razlikuju.
- Čim nađemo jedan par koji se razlikuje, tekst nije palindrom: `return false` odmah završava funkciju i ostatak se ne proverava.
text.en:
We compare the character on the left with the character on the right.

- `cleaned[left]` is the character at index `left`, and `cleaned[right]` the character at index `right`.
- `!==` is strict inequality: `true` if the characters differ.
- As soon as we find one pair that differs, the text is not a palindrome: `return false` ends the function immediately and the rest is not checked.

text.sr:
Levi pokazivač ide jedno mesto udesno.

- `left++` znači „dodaj 1 na `left`“, tj. isto što i `left = left + 1`.
text.en:
The left pointer moves one place to the right.

- `left++` means “add 1 to `left`”, i.e. the same as `left = left + 1`.

text.sr:
Desni pokazivač ide jedno mesto ulevo.

- `right--` znači „oduzmi 1 od `right`“, tj. isto što i `right = right - 1`.
- Tako se pokazivači približavaju sredini, a petlja proverava sledeći par.

Tok:

```
cleaned = 'level'   (indeksi 0..4)
left=0, right=4 → 'l' i 'l' isti → dalje
left=1, right=3 → 'e' i 'e' isti → dalje
left=2, right=2 → 2 < 2 nije tačno → kraj petlje → true

cleaned = 'hello'
left=0, right=4 → 'h' i 'o' različiti → return false
```
text.en:
The right pointer moves one place to the left.

- `right--` means “subtract 1 from `right`”, i.e. the same as `right = right - 1`.
- This way the pointers move toward the middle, and the loop checks the next pair.

Flow:

```
cleaned = 'level'   (indexes 0..4)
left=0, right=4 → 'l' and 'l' are equal → continue
left=1, right=3 → 'e' and 'e' are equal → continue
left=2, right=2 → 2 < 2 is not true → end of the loop → true

cleaned = 'hello'
left=0, right=4 → 'h' and 'o' differ → return false
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 5.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 5.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Svi parovi su se poklopili: tekst je palindrom.

- Do ove linije se stiže samo ako `return false` u liniji 6 nijednom nije izvršen.
- Za prazan tekst petlja se nije ni izvršila, pa je rezultat `true`, što test traži.
text.en:
All pairs matched: the text is a palindrome.

- This line is reached only if `return false` on line 6 never ran.
- For empty text the loop did not even run, so the result is `true`, which the test requires.

note.sr: Ne pravi obrnuti string i staje na prvoj razlici; poredi najviše polovinu znakova.
note.en: It does not build a reversed string and stops at the first difference; it compares at most half of the characters.
